recentItems.title: Varnamaala Video Song [Telugu] | Gatha Vaibhavam | Dushyanth | Ashika Ranganath |Simple Suni|Judah S
recentItems.description:
Watch the beautiful Varnamaala Video Song from the Telugu movie Gatha Vaibhavam, featuring SS Dushyanth and Ashika Ranganath.

The song brings together the soulful voices of Anurag Kulkarni and Chinmayi Sripada, with music composed, arranged and produced by Judah Sandhy and lyrics penned by Krishna Kanth. The film is written and directed by Simple Suni.

This epic fantasy drama blends history, mythology, and destiny. 
When Purathan and Adhunika meet in the present, they are drawn into a mystical journey through their past lives — from the divine Devaloka, to Vasco da Gama’s voyage, and the coastal lands of pre-independence Karnataka. Will their love survive across lifetimes, or is history doomed to repeat itself?
